Tower of Ascension (Quest)#002.src: I challenge you to reach the final floor!
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#002.dst: Son kata ulaşman için sana meydan okuyorum!
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#002.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#003.src: Have you got what it takes to conquer it?
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#003.dst: Onu fethetmek için gereken şey sende var mı?
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#003.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#004.src: Perhaps you would like to know the layout of the tower first? Hehehehe...
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#004.dst: Belki önce kulenin düzenini öğrenmek istersin? Hehehehe...
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#004.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#005.src: There are {~} floors in this tower, each with ten levels.
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#005.dst: Bu kulede {~} kat var, her birinde on seviye.
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#005.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#006.src: Each floor has nine regular levels and one boss level.
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#006.dst: Her katta dokuz normal seviye ve bir boss seviyesi var.
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#006.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#007.src: To pass a regular level, you must collect five tokens from the challenge on that level, and one token from boss levels.
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#007.dst: Normal bir seviyeyi geçmek için o seviyedeki mücadeleden beş jeton, boss seviyelerinden ise bir jeton toplamalısın.
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#007.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#008.src: After you beat a whole floor, you will return here and you can begin the next one...
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#008.dst: Bütün bir katı bitirdiğinde buraya döneceksin ve sonrakine başlayabileceksin...
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#008.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#009.src: So, what do you say? Hehehe...
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#009.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#010.src: Turn left and head to the first floor...if you dare...
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#010.dst: Sola dön ve ilk kata git... cesaretin varsa...
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#010.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#011.src: Well done, adventurer, you have successfully completed this floor! You may proceed.
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#011.dst: Aferin maceracı, bu katı başarıyla tamamladın! İlerleyebilirsin.
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#011.speaker: Floormaster

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#012.src: You have completed my tower, I see...
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#012.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#013.src: Did you enjoy Death? Many challengers certainly did. Her power is... unmatched, hehehe...
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#013.dst: Ölüm'den hoşlandın mı? Pek çok meydan okuyucu kesinlikle hoşlandı. Gücü... eşsizdir, hehehe...
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#013.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#014.src: A tower of madness, fueled by Death herself... Quite a challenge, yes?
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#014.dst: Bizzat Ölüm'ün beslediği bir delilik kulesi... Epey zorlu, değil mi?
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#014.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#015.src: You have joined us now, champion... Few can claim this victory as their own. Fewer still have held their mind.
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#015.dst: Artık bize katıldın, şampiyon... Bu zaferi sahiplenebilen azdır. Aklını koruyabilen daha da az.
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#015.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#016.src: For this honor... A reward, for you. You have truly earned it... Hehehehe...
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#016.dst: Bu onur için... Sana bir ödül. Gerçekten hak ettin... Hehehehe...
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#016.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#018.src: I need five tokens from the enemies in this room as evidence that you are strong enough to ascend.
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#018.dst: Yükselecek kadar güçlü olduğunun kanıtı olarak bu odadaki düşmanlardan beş jeton istiyorum.

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#019.src: And you... You are unlike them all, yes? Few have managed to ascend these floors.
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#019.dst: Ve sen... Hepsinden farklısın, değil mi? Bu katları çıkmayı başaran pek az kişi oldu.
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#019.speaker:
Ankou
